Requirement You are wielding a loaded chemical or incendiary weapon.

Area 15-foot cone

Duration 1 minute

Empty the tank across the cone. Each creature in the area takes the weapon’s damage with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. The ground in the cone then remains hazardous for the duration: a creature that enters it or ends its turn there takes persistent damage of the weapon’s type. This is the baseline every other Foul Iron feat is built on.
